text: hi I'm Travis and maybe you're like me I followed all the society's rules I did everything that was supposed to and I ended up getting a corporate job which I later realized is basically prison not surprisingly I had a complete mental breakdown I ended up checking myself into the emergency room because things were so bad I was having a complete panic attack and I realized very quickly that
